model_output.verdict: Your hospital nursing experience fits the medical-surgical track, and I'd take a close look at your charge and precepting work. I'd hesitate because the resume doesn't show your usual patient assignment or establish the license this Raleigh role requires.
write_up: Your experience as a Registered Nurse at Riverside Methodist and Mount Carmel East points toward this medical-surgical role. It's common for nursing resumes to list core duties, but yours doesn't yet show the patient assignments or unit work that would distinguish you in a pile.

The Epic line is your best model: it names both the records you documented and the system you used. Your RN, BLS, ACLS and BSN are easy to find, but the resume doesn't establish whether your license meets the North Carolina requirement.

Let's start with your current Riverside role. Add your unit and typical patient assignment, then show what you handle as charge nurse and teach new graduates. Bring your surgical care and Epic experience forward for this application.
